subject: ddl: consider paused job when check runnable (#54419)
summary: Reviewed the first-parent diff in DDL scheduling/runningJobs: paused jobs are treated as non-runnable and their involved objects are added to `pending` so conflicting DDL isn’t scheduled (including across general/reorg pools); `finishOrPendJob` closes the `allIDs()`→`checkRunnable()` race. No remaining Blocker/High issues found.
